text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: On the day of the Elms Stakes race, Haru Urara is much more serious than usual.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Right before the start of the race, her shopping district friends, who have come a long way in order to support her, start cheering her on, explaining that they want to see her win.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Hearing their cheers, Haru Urara feels something different than her usual excitement…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She rushes out to the track… She's not running just for fun this time—she's running to win.
